notes: The MI-909 is a two-piece UHF digital stereo in-ear-monitoring (IEM) system: the MI-909T half-rack transmitter (documented above, all physical I/O sourced from MIPRO's official product page and official MI-909T User Guide PDF rear-panel diagram) and the MI-909R bodypack receiver. The MI-909R has only ONE physical port — a 3.5mm stereo TRS earphone output — confirmed via its official User Guide; it uses two fixed (permanently attached) whip antennas and is powered by 2x AA batteries with no external DC/USB/charging port, so it contributes no further connectors. "Wireless mic" was chosen as the closest available `type` value; the MI-909T is technically a UHF digital IEM transmitter (its two combo inputs accept mic- or line-level signal, per MIPRO's spec of selectable Line/Mic gain modes up to +26dBu), not a microphone transmitter. Chassis is a half-rack (9.5" W x ~1.73"/44mm H x ~8.1"/206mm D, ~1.1kg) unit — natively 1U-height but requires the optional MIPRO FB-71 rack-ear kit to mount in a standard 19" rack (typically pairing two half-rack units side by side into 1U); rackUnits set to 1 to reflect its native 1U-height chassis. No bandwidth "grade" applies to any port: audio I/O is analog, the antenna port is RF, and the REMOTE ports are a proprietary low-speed control bus, not a graded connector type. No power/frequency-plan/regional variant issues were found that affect the physical I/O count.

ports.name: AF IN (L) MONO
ports.note: Combo XLR/6.3mm TRS jack; when used alone (mono) also acts as the primary line/mic input.

ports.name: Antenna
ports.note: Physical connector is a 50-ohm TNC (threaded BNC-family) female jack; TNC is not in the allowed connector list, so BNC (closest match) was chosen.

ports.name: REMOTE OUT
ports.note: Small modular RJ-style jack for MIPRO's proprietary ACT Bus (daisy-chain link/sync between MI-909T units) — not a standard Ethernet port; likely RJ-11/RJ-9 sized in reality. rj45 chosen as closest allowed connector; no network grade applies.

ports.name: REMOTE IN
ports.note: See REMOTE OUT — ACT Bus link jack, not Ethernet.

ports.name: DC IN (12-15V)
ports.note: Powered by supplied external 12–15VDC / 0.5A switching power adapter (100-240V AC input).
